summary.intent: Fix ultraplan session creation failures caused by git repository corruption, reduce 14GB bundle size via LFS migration, and harden the Claude/Gemini/Pi development environment against recurrence.
summary.outcome: All blockers resolved: git tree corruption fixed (157 → 0 bad trees), bundle reduced from 14GB to 588MB via LFS + filter-repo history rewrite, GitHub remote connected with clean history (secrets scrubbed), plugins trimmed from 15 to 6 to restore ultraplan built-in command routing, and CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB disabled to restore bash access in headless sessions.

repo: Entire.io 'carry forward: uncommitted session files' commits absolute paths (e.g. /home/mike-anderson/.claude/plans/) outside the repo root, creating empty-filename tree entries that corrupt git objects in a way git cannot recover from without deleting the branch
entire/ shadow branches are designed to be local-only — pushing them via 'git push --all' violates Entire.io's design; only entire/checkpoints/v1 should be remote
git lfs migrate import creates refs/replace/ entries that keep old blobs reachable, preventing GC; must delete these refs before repack will actually shrink the repo
The bundle round-trip method (clone from bundle into new dir, swap .git/objects/) is the reliable way to get a clean object store when repack -Ad fails to prune unreachable blobs
shared_gemini.html (saved Gemini UI page) contained embedded Google API keys — triggered GitHub secret scanning; session JSONL telemetry also logged API keys from Gemini responses
CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 in settings.json strips sandbox initialization env vars from subprocess Claude sessions, silently breaking bash access in all headless/subagent/claude-p invocations
15+ plugins with hookify caused the skill routing table to intercept /ultraplan before the CLI built-in command handler, resulting in 'Unknown skill: ultraplan'
package.json was a 0-byte empty file, causing Pi v0.66.1 ESM extension loader to fail with 'Invalid package config'

code.finding: Log injection via f-string interpolation of user input; CodeQL flagged it; fixed by switching to %s-style parameterized logging

workflow: git filter-repo --replace-text with an expressions file is the correct tool for scrubbing secrets from all history; git rebase/filter-branch approaches are slower and less reliable
GitHub secret scanning alerts must be explicitly resolved via API even after secrets are scrubbed from history — they do not auto-close
transfer.fsckObjects=false cannot bypass empty-filename tree errors because they are hard parse failures in git's tree format reader, not fsck-level checks
git bundle create --all includes every ref including corrupted entire/ branches; partial bundle (excluding entire/) works as a diagnostic step
Running 'entire clean --all' periodically is essential — 1048 shadow branches accumulated in 5 weeks without cleanup
When git lfs migrate rewrites commits, the replace refs it creates must be deleted before repack can actually reclaim space

The platform-health-sentinel.sh pattern (proactive at session start, reactive after failure, self-healing mode) is a sound cross-platform monitoring architecture for shared services (SurrealDB, Ollama, Vault)

friction: Force-push deny rules in settings.json required repeated temporary removal to complete legitimate history rewrites — needed a cleaner escape hatch for authorized destructive operations
git repack -Ad did not prune unreachable blobs because refs/replace/ entries created by lfs migrate kept old objects reachable — required discovering and deleting 5648 replace refs manually
GitHub secret scanning blocked the push even after the secret was redacted in HEAD — required filter-repo history scrub AND manual alert resolution via API
CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 was silently breaking all headless Claude sessions with no clear error message about the cause
Plugin routing (hookify + 14 others) intercepted /ultraplan with 'Unknown skill' — built-in CLI commands should take priority over plugin skill routes
CronCreate task auto-expires after 7 days — not suitable for truly persistent automation without GitHub Actions or systemd
Entire.io hasDotgit error when pushing certain shadow branches caused those branches to be un-pushable and required local deletion
open_items: GitHub Actions scheduled workflow for weekly repo health monitoring (sentinel cron auto-expires in 7 days)
Rotate the HuggingFace API token that was exposed in commit history (token was scrubbed from git but the token itself should be revoked on huggingface.co)
28 remaining informational-severity CodeQL alerts not yet triaged
Branch protection ruleset exists but has 0 rules — no required CI status checks or review requirements on main
Vulnerability alerts (Dependabot) still disabled on the GitHub repo
3 stale Entire.io shadow branches still on GitHub remote (deleted locally, need GitHub UI cleanup or they'll age out)
Bundle size grew from 182MB back to 588-724MB after the shared_gemini.html filter-repo pass — could be trimmed further
Ultraplan not yet confirmed working end-to-end — repo health blockers fixed but actual ultraplan session creation not verified in transcript
SurrealDB genesis tables (journey_transitions, neurons, etc.) population not verified — retrospective Step 4 was skipped
Graph HIHO health score not calculated — retrospective Step 8 graph health check not completed
Pi agent skill index health and extension loading not re-verified after package.json fix
